description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the ReviewerRating entity in the OrangeHRM performance module. It tests the creation, persistence, and retrieval of ReviewerRating objects with related entities.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the ReviewerRating entity, testing persistence and retrieval of reviewer ratings and their related entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific database tables related to performance reviews, reviewers, KPIs, job titles, and reviewer ratings.

methods.name: testReviewerRatingEntity
methods.description: Creates instances of related entities, sets properties, persists them, then retrieves and asserts their values to verify correct entity persistence and relationships.
